source: export function packExports(pkg) { const declaration = (value) => value.replace('./src/', './dist/').replace(/\.tsx?$/, '.d.ts'); const output = (value) => value.replace('./src/', './dist/').replace(/\.tsx?$/, '.js'); return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(pkg.exports).map(([key, value]) => { if (value === null) return [key, null]; if (!/\.tsx?$/.test(value)) return [key, value]; return [key, { import: output(value), types: declaration(value) }]; })); }
